request.raw_text: Design a fixation rod mounted from the top with arm length 200mm to have ability to fix cutting product

aim.primary_aim: Provide a top-mounted fixation rod with a 200 mm arm length that can secure the cutting product.

functional_design_intentions.name: Cutting product fixation
functional_design_intentions.description: The fixation rod is intended to secure the cutting product during use.

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all non-targeted geometry except where modification is necessary to accommodate the top-mounted fixation rod.

geometry.description: A fixation rod with an arm exists and is mounted from the top of the model.

functions.name: Product fixation
functions.description: The fixation rod provides the ability to secure the cutting product.

behaviors.name: Constrain product motion
behaviors.description: When engaged with the cutting product, the fixation rod constrains its unintended motion.

validation_criteria.description: The final model contains a fixation rod mounted from the top.
The fixation rod arm has the requested length.
The fixation rod can secure the cutting product.
The fixation rod constrains unintended motion of the cutting product when engaged.
Non-targeted model geometry remains unchanged except where required for the fixation rod attachment.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact top mounting location, orientation, and attachment interface are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Mount the rod on the uppermost available mounting region.
Mount the rod on a specific top feature intended by the engineer but not identified in the request.

unresolved_requirements.description: It is unclear whether the stated 200 mm arm length refers to the entire rod, a projecting portion of the rod, or a separate arm attached to the rod.
candidate_interpretations: The fixation rod itself forms a 200 mm arm.
A separate arm extending from the fixation rod has a length of 200 mm.
Only the projecting reach from the mounting location is 200 mm.

unresolved_requirements.description: The rod profile, material, fixation mechanism, adjustment requirements, and cutting-product contact interface are unspecified.
candidate_interpretations: A rigid rod directly contacts and holds the cutting product.
The rod supports an unspecified clamp or other fixation element.
The rod is adjustable and is locked after positioning.
